description: Expected codes are derived by hand from the rule text. Under `--dev`, AGSC-11-08 exempts `127.0.0.0/8` and `::1/128` from the closed list, and `::1` is the one address of `::/96` admitted; an IPv4-mapped or IPv4-compatible address that embeds a loopback address stays refused, because those ranges are refused whole. Derivation: b.example resolves to `127.0.0.1`, inside `127.0.0.0/8`, allowed under `--dev`; c.example resolves to `0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1`, the address `::1` written in full, allowed under `--dev`; d.example resolves to `::ffff:127.0.0.1`, inside `::ffff:0:0/96`, refused; e.example resolves to `::127.0.0.1`, inside `::/96` and not `::1`, refused.
